tagline.en: Swiss privacy-brand travel eSIM with bundled VPN — big-data long-validity plans
tagline.zh: 瑞士隐私品牌旅行eSIM，附赠VPN、大流量长有效期

description.en: Stellar Security sells destination-based travel eSIMs from a Swiss privacy company; every eSIM bundles the full Stellar VPN for the whole plan period. Entry plans from €1.21 (Turkey 3GB/30d); 50GB/180-day tiers exist (€15.27, Turkey). Payments by card, PayPal, or crypto (BTC/XMR/USDT). Community hands-on (single-user, unverified): HK landing IP with SG split routing, ~€11.x for 100GB, China Mobile roaming behavior without roaming icon, no 5G.
description.zh: Stellar Security 是瑞士隐私公司旗下的目的地制旅行 eSIM，每张 eSIM 附赠整个套餐期可用的完整版 Stellar VPN。入门套餐 1.21 欧元起（土耳其 3GB/30天），有 50GB/180 天大容量档（15.27 欧）。支持银行卡、PayPal 与加密货币（BTC/XMR/USDT）支付。社区单用户实测（未官方证实）：香港落地 IP、新加坡分流、100GB 约 11 欧元档、国内使用走移动网络无漫游图标、连不上 5G。

details.en:
Stellar Security positions itself as a privacy-first travel eSIM: Swiss jurisdiction, free full Stellar VPN (normally €9.99/mo) bundled for the entire plan validity, and anonymous payment rails (PayPal, BTC, XMR, USDT). The eSIM is data-only, installs up to 180 days ahead, and activates on first connection at the destination; some plans support top-up. The "Stellar Data" app handles usage and reloads.

Pricing is per destination; officially verified samples (2026-09): Turkey 3GB/30d €1.21, Turkey 50GB/180d €15.27. The community-reported 100GB/~€11 tier with HK landing + SG split routing was not found on official pages during the 2026-09 check — treat those numbers as third-party hands-on, subject to change.

Hands-on notes from a single community user (2026-09, unverified): roaming worked well in mainland China over what appeared to be China Mobile with no roaming icon shown, speeds close to a local SIM, but 5G would not connect (LTE only).
details.zh:
Stellar Security 主打隐私优先的旅行 eSIM：瑞士司法辖区、每张卡附赠整个套餐期的完整版 Stellar VPN（VPN 单独订阅 9.99 欧/月）、支持 PayPal/BTC/XMR/USDT 等匿名支付。纯数据卡，最迟能提前 180 天安装，到达目的地首次联网激活，部分套餐支持充值。官方 App「Stellar Data」管理用量。

价格为目的地定价制，2026-09 官方页核验样例：土耳其 3GB/30天 1.21 欧、土耳其 50GB/180天 15.27 欧。社区流传的 100GB 约 11 欧元、香港落地+新加坡分流的口径在官方页面未找到——以上数字属第三方实测，随时可能变动。

社区单用户实测补充（2026-09，未核实）：中国大陆漫游体验好，疑似走移动网络、不显示漫游图标，速率接近本地卡，但始终连不上 5G（仅 LTE）。

bestFor.en: Privacy-minded travellers who want big-data, long-validity eSIMs and bundled VPN.
bestFor.zh: 注重隐私、需要大流量长有效期并附赠 VPN 的旅行用户。

en: Full Stellar VPN bundled for the whole plan period
Install up to 180 days ahead; top-up supported on some plans

最迟提前180天安装，部分套餐可充值

en: Swiss privacy jurisdiction plus bundled VPN
Destination-based pricing is opaque — popular HK/SG community plans not listed publicly
Community-reported 5G not connecting in mainland China (unverified)
VPN-first brand means less telco transparency
zh: 目的地定价不透明，社区热门港/新套餐未公开挂出
社区实测国内连不上5G（未核实）
VPN品牌出身，电信侧透明度较低

plansNote.en: Official site prices (2026-09-25). The 100GB/~€11 HK+SG community plan was not found on official pages; user-reported only.

country.en: varies (community/test reports: Hong Kong and Singapore split by destination/service)
country.zh: varies (community/test reports: Hong Kong and Singapore split by destination/service)

note.en: Chinese review sites (esim.ss / shuziyimin, 2026) report Stellar's China plans ride China Mobile 4/5G with some routes exiting via Hong Kong and others via Singapore ('actual IP depends on assignment'); NodeLoc threads market its HK/SG breakouts. No official disclosure; IP type unknown.
note.zh: 中文评测站（esim.ss/数字移民，2026）：Stellar 中国套餐走中国移动 4/5G，部分线路香港出口、部分新加坡出口，实际 IP 以分配为准；NodeLoc 亦有港/新分流讨论。无官方披露，性质 unknown。
